sloka: ते तु हृष्टा विनर्दन्तो भिन्दन्त इव मेदिनीम्।नादं घोरं विमुञ्जन्तो निर्ययुर्जयकांक्षिणः ।। ६.९६.३१ ।।
transliteration: te tu hṛṣṭā vinardanto bhindanta iva medinīm।nādaṁ ghoraṁ vimuñjanto niryayurjayakāṁkṣiṇaḥ ।। 6.96.31 ।।

translations.english: Then Ravana surrounded by the army of Rakshasas lifted his bow, like the Lord Yama at the time of dissolution of the universe, went for the battle glowing.
